scenarios.title: Malformed matcher votes fail closed to the labeled keyword fallback
scenarios.acceptanceRef: Cross-cutting: malformed/truncated/empty matcher output and partial vote rounds

units.text: Russian forces conducted a large one-way drone strike series against Odesa port infrastructure overnight on August 11 to 12.
Senior interlocutors continued consultations on the broader framework understanding, with participants signaling readiness for further engagement.

evidence.text: Port infrastructure in Odesa was reportedly damaged in a large overnight drone strike on August 11 to 12.

matcherFixture.inheritedLadder: llm-majority (>=3 usable rounds) -> llm (1-2 usable rounds; the single/first usable round scores) -> keyword (0 usable rounds). Labels always disclose the rung and can never masquerade as a majority (contract section 6.3 as amended; register #8 H2).

expected.behavior: Discard the empty, truncated, null, and wrong-schema votes without repairing or guessing them; with exactly 1 usable round the INHERITED ladder scores from that single round, labeled matcher llm with voteRounds 1 - honestly non-majority, and NOT the keyword fallback.

With zero usable rounds the evaluator falls back to the keyword matcher, labeled keyword, never presented as a majority. The full declared-unit denominator STILL applies: the signal-less unit u1 stays in the denominator as an automatic miss and the result carries keywordUnmatchable: 1 (contract section 6.3 keyword-fallback denominator rule; register #8 M1).

expected.notes: Pins BOTH rungs of the INHERITED degradation ladder (contract section 6.3 as amended; register #8 H2) over one degenerate vote round set each: variant A (1 usable round of 5) scores from the single usable round, labeled matcher llm / voteRounds 1 - honestly non-majority and NOT keyword; variant B (0 usable rounds) falls back to the keyword matcher labeled keyword. Malformed votes are discarded, never repaired. Unit u1 is deliberately SIGNAL-LESS (no gazetteer toponym, no action keyword): under the keyword rung it STAYS in the declared-unit denominator as an automatic miss counted in keywordUnmatchable - the conflict evaluator's disclosed divergence from production scoreDigest's matchable-subset denominator (M1). Per-unit verdicts are identical under both variants (u0 matched, u1 miss), so the headline pin (M4) is 1/2 in both populations under either rung.

scenarios.title: Malformed cutoff falls to the publishedAt window END (rung 2)
scenarios.acceptanceRef: Cross-cutting: missing and malformed cutoff/publication timestamps - window END rung 2 (windowEndSource: published; Gate-0 science M2)

units.text: Russian forces conducted an overnight one-way drone strike against port infrastructure in Izmail on the night of August 13 to 14, damaging a grain-loading berth.

evidence.text: Port authorities reportedly recorded damage to a grain-loading berth in Izmail after an overnight drone strike on August 13 to 14.

expected.notes: Pins rung 2 of the FROZEN window END ladder (contract section 5, register #6: cutoffAt when parseable -> publishedAt when known -> exclusive end of the report date's UTC day). cutoffAt is present but UNPARSEABLE, publishedAt is valid and falls after midnight UTC, so the window END is the publishedAt instant and the recorded windowEndSource is published (section 6.4, M2). Claim 9324 (claimDate 2026-08-14) is included ONLY because the END fell to publishedAt: under a typical same-day cutoff (rung 1) or under rung 3 (report-day end) it would be off_window. Recording windowEndSource on every evaluation makes a cutoff-parser regression that silently widens or narrows windows visible in the results themselves. Snapshot-kind availability stays governed by section 6.2 and is not pinned here.

scenarios.title: other_in_scope requires an actor/geography hit plus a generic security signal
scenarios.acceptanceRef: Cross-cutting: other_in_scope gate (contract section 5 — a generic security signal ALONE never reaches other_in_scope; topic-less region mentions never reach it either)

evidence.text: Authorities in Tehran announced expanded security measures around government facilities on August 9.
Regional analysts discussed broader security trends during a televised panel.

expected.notes: Pins BOTH sides of the classifier's rung-6 gate (contract section 5: other_in_scope needs an actor or geography hit PLUS a generic security signal). Claim 9330 carries a laned-null geography hit (Tehran) and a generic security signal with no earlier-rung lane, so it lands other_in_scope via the gate. Claim 9331 carries the generic security signal ALONE — no actor hit, no geography hit, no region token — so it is unclassified: the signal by itself never manufactures scope. Added at the Phase 3 Gate-3 remediation (ADDITIVE: no committed scenario edited).

scenarios.title: One vague claim never satisfies two distinct declared units
scenarios.acceptanceRef: Cross-cutting: atomic/compound policy — a vague claim overlapping two distinct units topically is materially equivalent to neither and receives credit for zero units (register #9 deferred pin; contract section 6.3 as amended, Gate-0 science L1)

units.text: Houthi forces launched two ballistic missiles toward the southern Red Sea shipping lane southwest of Al Salif on August 9; both fell into the sea without striking a vessel.
Houthi forces released the detained crew of a survey vessel at Al Hudaydah port on August 9 after holding the crew for three weeks.

evidence.text: Houthi maritime activity reportedly continued across the Red Sea area on August 9.
Two ballistic missiles reportedly fell into the southern Red Sea shipping lane southwest of Al Salif on August 9 without striking a vessel.

matcherFixture.atomicCompoundPolicy: One claim may match multiple units ONLY when it is materially equivalent to EACH unit independently (contract section 6.3 as amended; Gate-0 science L1; register #9). Topic overlap alone never suffices, and this rule binds generally — not only inside the disabled atomization experiment.

expected.notes: The register #9 DEFERRED pin, delivered at Phase 4 (ADDITIVE: no committed scenario edited). Two DISTINCT same-day Houthi maritime events; claim 9401 is deliberately VAGUE ('maritime activity continued') — it topically overlaps BOTH units and is materially equivalent to NEITHER, so it receives credit for ZERO units (matcherFixture.expected.creditedUnits is empty). The specific claim 9402 matches u0 alone; u1 stays an honest miss in both populations. A matcher that pairs the vague claim with either unit — or with both — on shared actor/topic/region alone violates section 6.3 and is caught by this scenario plus the matcherFixture pin.
